name: Rule Obsolescence and Ossification
definition: A rule persists after the conditions that justified it have changed, and resists revision.
trigger_conditions: Amendment requires a supermajority of a population that has stopped participating
No scheduled review of parameters against outcomes exists
Parameters were set once at launch

institutional_antecedent.mechanism: adaptability requires dynamic elements in the rulemaking process itself

citation: W. A. Kaal, ed., Agent Failure Mode Registry version 1.0, AFMR-F030 Rule Obsolescence and Ossification. https://wulfkaal.github.io/afmr/AFMR-F030
assessment_note: State which trigger conditions the assessed design satisfies. Report this family as examined even where no exposure is found. A parameter recommendation stated without its conditions is not conforming output under section 7.
